currentRoundInspection.title: Český Krumlov Castle
currentRoundInspection.status: Two inspected pictures and standard viewer data used for individual authoring; current QA is separate.

pictures.notes: Close oblique of the lower castle tower: faceted circular masonry base, salmon/cream pilaster rhythm, open arched gallery, stacked dark flared roof/cupola and lantern. Red roofs, selected pale chimneys and lower castle ranges are visible; upper ridge palace is behind. Linked photo inspected in browser, not downloaded or used as a texture.

Full ridge compound viewed across the river: unequal connected red-roofed ranges and open courtyards, tower at the eastern/lower end, pale upper palace above rock, western stacked covered bridge to the separate pale/grey-roofed theater. River, garden and village remain context. Linked picture inspected in browser, not downloaded or used as a texture.

currentRoundInspection.limits: Use these two pictures and the standard viewer data for approximate exterior fit. Heights, painted motifs, courtyard levels and terrain/bridge joins remain estimates; no bespoke surveys or historical research campaign.
